audit.framework_rationale: TensorCircuit performs state preparation, gate construction, circuit evolution, Hamiltonian construction, expectation evaluation, and reduced-state entropy computation. JAX supplies differentiation and loop execution, Optax supplies Adam, and NumPy supplies initialization and output conversion. No other quantum framework is imported.
audit.cheating_rationale: Histories come directly from objective evaluations during optimization. There are no fabricated results, hidden-answer reads, evaluator modifications, or reward manipulation. The fixed random seed provides reproducibility.
audit.fidelity_rationale: The source implements the specified initial state, open-boundary staggered XXZ Hamiltonian, 243 independent parameters, six alternating sublayers, and three complete-block entropy checkpoints. Combining rotations and interactions into disjoint two-qubit gates preserves the prescribed circuit. Doubling interaction angles correctly compensates for TensorCircuit's half-angle convention. [TensorCircuit gate source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tencent-quantum-lab/tensorcircuit/master/tensorcircuit/gates.py). The loss uses evaluator-provided targets and weight, initialization has standard deviation 0.02, and Adam performs exactly config['max_steps'] updates at the configured learning rate. All four NumPy histories record pre-update values. The remaining entropy mismatch is an optimization outcome, not an omitted penalty.
audit.implementation_error_rationale: No obvious implementation error is present. The subsystem_to_keep argument selects the intended left half, and Renyi order 2 computes the required purity-based entropy. [TensorCircuit quantum API](https://tensorcircuit-ng.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api/quantum.html). Parameter shapes, boundary rotations, energy normalization, and history timing are consistent with the task.
